items.detail: AI adoption across Mexico’s manufacturing, finance, and healthcare sectors
details: Lead a nine-week research project examining barriers to AI adoption across Mexico’s manufacturing, finance, and healthcare sectors.
Design the research methodology, interview protocols, and stakeholder strategy for 20+ interviews across companies, industry associations, and government.
Synthesize qualitative and market data into implementation bottlenecks, startup opportunities, and evidence-based policy recommendations.
Selected as one of 25 fellows from more than 300 applicants for applied training in ethics, technology, and public policy.
Drafted research memos, policy briefs, and stakeholder materials translating technical risks into recommendations for responsible technology development.

items.detail: Market research, product analysis, and impact evaluation
details: Conducted market research, product-development analysis, and impact evaluation for social-enterprise clients in education technology, sustainability, and disability access.
Synthesized findings into client-ready deliverables with prioritized recommendations supporting pricing and go-to-market decisions.
Conducted market, consumer-behavior, and competitive analyses for small businesses and nonprofits.
Translated findings into recommendations for messaging, digital marketing, and user experience.
Supported cross-functional operations projects spanning facilities, budgeting, emergency planning, and transportation.
Built financial tracking models for deferred-maintenance spending, improving visibility into budgets, variance, and long-term capital needs.
Coordinated with transportation, facilities, and finance teams to implement operational improvements across departments.
